title: Dollar Falls and Stock Market Rises
subtitle: Financial Market Reacts to Presidential Election Results
excerpt: Dollar falls to $5 and stock market rises nearly 8%
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brazil's financial market reacted with a strong rise to the result of the first round of the presidential elections.

The dollar fell to around $5, while the Ibovespa advanced nearly 8% and exceeded 200,000 points.

This rise in the financial market reflects investors' reaction to the election results.

With information from Agência Brasil.
